item.title: Issue #3052 created
item.description:
`fn:update`: refinement of actions

The newest version of fn:update provides dedicated update actions. Some of them could be tweaked:

1. Deletions

When no action is supplied, selected nodes will be deleted. We could introduce a delete action, with an empty sequence as value:

(: current syntax :)
update($bookstore, fn { //book/@new })
(: suggested change :)
update($bookstore, fn { //book/@new }, { 'delete': () })

If we do so, we will need to add rules for users supplying both delete and other actions.

2. Naming

  • The actions before and after could be renamed to prepend and append.
  • Should we rename value?
